from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


class ComposeContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.compose = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "docker-compose.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def _default_int(self, name: str) -> int:
        pattern = rf"{re.escape(name)}:\s*\$\{{{re.escape(name)}:-([0-9]+)\}}"
        match = re.search(pattern, self.compose)
        self.assertIsNotNone(match, f"{name} must retain an integer Compose default")
        return int(match.group(1))

    def test_compose_teacher_dialog_lease_covers_declared_timeout_budget(self) -> None:
        dependency_timeout = self._default_int("DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS")
        ai_prompt_timeout = self._default_int("AI_PROMPT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS")
        worker_lease = self._default_int("TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS")
        self.assertGreater(worker_lease, 2 * ai_prompt_timeout + 4 * dependency_timeout)

    def test_compose_declares_an_explicit_container_bind_address(self) -> None:
        self.assertRegex(self.compose, r'HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS:\s*"0\.0\.0\.0"')


    def test_compose_uses_project_scoped_lw_network(self) -> None:
        self.assertRegex(self.compose, r"(?m)^    networks:\n      - lw-net$")
        self.assertRegex(self.compose, r"(?m)^networks:\n  lw-net:\s*$")
        self.assertNotRegex(self.compose, r"(?m)^    external:")

    def test_compose_bootstraps_teacher_runtime_streams(self) -> None:
        self.assertRegex(self.compose, r"(?m)^  nats-bootstrap:$")
        self.assertRegex(
            self.compose,
            r"(?ms)^    depends_on:\n      nats-bootstrap:\n        condition: service_completed_successfully$",
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
